metadata.description: CandyCo's internal Claude Code plugin marketplace.

plugins.name: candyco-design-system
plugins.description: CandyCo's design system — colors, typography, voice, components, fonts, logos, the paged 8.5×11 report template, and board-deck scaffolding. The default visual language for every CandyCo artifact.

plugins.name: candyco-mrp
plugins.description: Procurement MRP: say 'run MRP Hack Report' with a finished-good item number and get a one-page ~30-week MRP report (Excel + HTML) for every purchased component of its multi-level BOM, straight from live NetSuite. Replaces the manual item-by-item Copy & Paste process.

plugins.name: candyco-labor-detail
plugins.description: Amy's daily Labor Detail with Claude: rebuilds the Daily Report from the shift workbooks, schedules and NetSuite, walks the reviewer through the judgment calls, then builds and publishes the Labor Detail workbook and summary email.

plugins.name: candyco-rca-tracker
plugins.description: RCA rigor review: grades every new RCA from the Supervisors Toolkit line workbooks (6W2H, brainstorm, Gemba, root cause, actions, repeat failures), flags issue types for coaching, keeps the RCA Master Database in Continuous Improvement, and emails new reviews to Chad and Shawn. Owner: Shawn Jewkes.
